title: AnchorSIPS: A Synthetic Dataset and Evaluation Resource for Evidence-Supported Psychosis-Risk Symptom Measurement
abstract: arXiv:2608.12329v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Progress on AI for psychosis-risk assessment is limited by a data-access bottleneck. Real clinical interviews are difficult to share because of privacy, governance, and consent constraints. We present AnchorSIPS, a synthetic dataset of 10K structured psychosis-risk interviews with transcript-grounded measurement targets. Each interview is modeled on Mini-SIPS, a clinician-administered psychosis-risk interview. It captures history, 24 symptom questions, follow-up evidence for items the patient affirms, decisions about delusion-like symptoms (unusual beliefs), hallucination-like symptoms (unusual perceptions), and disorganized communication, exclusion of clear psychotic-level symptoms ("frank psychosis"), and a final attenuated psychosis syndrome (APS) diagnosis, a high-risk state of milder or early psychotic symptoms. translated_title: AnchorSIPS：一个用于证据支持的 psychosis 风险症状测量的合成数据集与评估资源
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.12329v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：精神病风险评估的 AI 进展受到数据访问瓶颈的限制。真实的临床访谈因隐私、治理和同意约束而难以共享。我们提出了 AnchorSIPS，一个包含 10K 个结构化精神病风险访谈的合成数据集，并带有基于转录本的测量目标。每个访谈均基于 Mini-SIPS（一种临床医生施测的精神病风险访谈）进行建模。它捕获了病史、24 个症状问题、对患者确认项目的后续证据、关于类妄想症状（异常信念）、类幻觉症状（异常感知）和混乱沟通的决定、排除明确的精神病级别症状（“明显精神病”），以及最终的衰减精神病综合征（APS）诊断，这是一种较轻或早期精神病症状的高风险状态。APS 诊断并非独立标签，它依赖于早期认可、支持性后续细节、症状特征的综合评估。
tldr: 本论文提出了 AnchorSIPS，一个基于 Mini-SIPS 的 10K 合成精神病风险访谈数据集，旨在解决真实临床数据共享受限的问题，并提供证据支持的 APS 诊断测量资源。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces AnchorSIPS, a synthetic dataset of 10K psychosis-risk interviews based on Mini-SIPS, addressing data-access bottlenecks and enabling evidence-supported APS diagnosis measurement.
